tools.description: Read a single tweet by URL or ID.

params.description: Tweet URL or tweet ID

params.description: Return only {id, text}. Rarely worth it for a single tweet; leave false unless you already know the author and URL.

tools.name: twitter-search
tools.description: Search X/Twitter for tweets matching a query. Returns token-optimized results with engagement metrics.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of results to return (default 10)

params.name: query
params.description: Search query string

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

params.name: text_only
params.description: Return only {id, text} per tweet; quoted tweets keep their text. Drops author, date, URL, and reply/retweet/like counts. Use when you only need tweet contents, e.g. summarising or scanning many result

params.description: Tweet URL or ID of any tweet in the thread
